mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS drops by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops by more than 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% YoY, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS increases > 5% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 10% and 5% YoY, respectively.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY.
